title: Thesis / Dissertation
purpose: Demonstrate an original, coherent and examinable body of scholarly work under the rules of the awarding institution.

sections.title: Preliminary Pages
sections.instruction: Institutional title page, declaration, certificate where required, acknowledgements, abstract, keywords, contents, lists of figures/tables, abbreviations and glossary. Follow institution rules.

sections.title: Introduction and Research Problem
sections.instruction: Context, problem, rationale, aims, research questions, hypotheses, scope, definitions and chapter map.

sections.title: Critical Literature Review
sections.instruction: Search strategy where applicable, theoretical foundations, thematic synthesis, competing positions, research gap and conceptual framework.

sections.title: Theoretical / Conceptual Framework
sections.instruction: Define constructs, assumptions, propositions, formal model and relationship to research questions.

sections.title: Research Methodology
sections.instruction: Research philosophy where relevant, design, sampling, instruments, datasets, procedures, analysis, validity, ethics and reproducibility.

sections.title: Research / Engineering Chapters
sections.instruction: Organize substantial contributions into coherent chapters. Each chapter states its question, method, findings and link to thesis argument.

sections.title: Results and Analysis
sections.instruction: Present complete results with uncertainty, negative findings and traceability to data.

sections.title: General Discussion
sections.instruction: Integrate chapter findings, contribution, originality, limitations and implications.

sections.title: Conclusions and Future Work
sections.instruction: Answer research questions, state contributions and bounded future directions.

sections.title: References
sections.instruction: Apply institutional citation style consistently; verify metadata and citation links.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.instruction: Protocols, instruments, source code, extended proofs, data dictionaries, ethics documents and supplementary evidence.

sections.title: Examination / Submission Compliance
sections.instruction: Map word limits, formatting, originality statement, embargo, repository deposit, permissions and required forms.
